title: Radius-valley age evolution around cool stars: calibrated gate, power grid, data, and code
description: A calibrated null/signal injection gate testing whether current archival data can distinguish a literature-sized age evolution of the sub-Neptune fraction from no effect around cool stars (Teff < 4200 K), with an FGK control. Includes a 15-cell power grid (500 replicates per cell), a full power-versus-effect curve, frozen checksummed inputs, an external TIME Table age-ordering check, publication figures, and provenance records. The gate returns FAIL (inconclusive) for both samples; even an eightfold inventory reaches only 23.2 percent detection. Version v2.1.0 adds the self-contained reproducibility bundle under repro/v2/. LaTeX manuscript source is withheld; data, code, results, and figures are shared.
